Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2 + `target:v18`:** it is the consumer follow-up of a v18 reservation (objectstack#23543 F5-http), by the grade pattern of its siblings F4 (objectui#12654) and F5-jsx: p1 only if the designer writes a refused name. That is not measured yet.

Out of bounds: a wait node's `eventType: 'webhook'` and `packages/types/src/data-protocol.ts`'s `'webhook'` action, which spec 18 leaves untouched (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `M`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (cloud on the maintainer's stance 「可以的话，ui 后续开发尽量用云 session，并且要求截图给我看」; lane scope on 「你也可以接ui车道的卡」; batch 3 on 「当前任务处理完，后续并发降到3」, this session's chat, 2026-10-16)
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason: measured on `main` `4857cd2`: none of these tables is on `@object-ui/app-shell`'s or `@object-ui/components`' entry (`exports` is `.` only, and neither `index.ts` re-exports `flow-node-config`, the simulator, the canvas parts or the viewer's sets). `engine.flowNode.http_request.label` lives in app-shell's own metadata-admin table, not in `@object-ui/i18n`, and `engine.flowNode.http.label` already exists beside it. The stored flow shape does not change. A change that has to touch a published face stops and is reported under `deviations`, and the seat amends this claim.
Responsibility: n/a — a spec 18 consumer follow-up

This seat's in-flight objectui#12707 and #12708 touch none of these files.
Measured at claim (the triage seat's question): the designer cannot write a reserved name. The add-node palette offers `http` (`flow-canvas-parts.tsx:356`), and `TYPE_ALIASES`' `http: 'http_request'` only picks the field group. So `priority:p2` stands. The defect runs the other way: the canvas icon switch (`:88–89`), the simulator's `MOCKED_SIDE_EFFECT` and `MOCKABLE`, and the viewer's `TECHNICAL_NODE_TYPES` list `http_request` but not `http`, so the canonical node misses its globe icon, is not mocked and is shown as a business step. The fix renames to `http`; it does not only delete.
